issues.issue: The MLP bars are purple, the paper's accent for our method. Every bar here is the filter's gain, but a reader sees purple and reads 'ours' versus a gold baseline, so the legend semantics invert. The spec asked for muted blue and orange matching Figure 1, and the script's own note says the colors differ from that plan.
issues.fix: Give the two baselines their Figure 1 hues (muted blue for logistic regression, muted orange for MLP, or whatever Figure 1 uses) via sf.color, and keep purple out of this plot. Confirm Figure 1 calls the same names. If the theme assigns purple to the MLP, change the theme mapping instead of this script.

issues.issue: The per-seed dots are tiny (s=5) and dark, and they are hard to see on the 0% bars and the narrow breast-cancer bars. The 'every seed favors the filter' claim rests on them.
issues.fix: Raise the dot size to about s=9 with a thin white edge, and reduce the jitter slightly so the dots do not drift off the bar.

issues.issue: The legend does not say what the dots and error bars are, and the caption has to carry that.
issues.fix: Keep the caption's 'dots are individual seeds, error bars 95% CI of the paired difference'. Optionally add a small gray 'zero = no gain' label at the zero line in the left panel.

issues.issue: The 0% bars and their dots overlap the gray zero line, so the 'near zero or slightly negative' point is easy to miss at this scale. The dominant visual is the 40% MLP bar.
issues.fix: Make the zero line slightly darker and thicker (lw 1.0). Keep the shared y axis, since it supports the growth message.

issues.issue: The caption draft is missing 'digits (left) and breast cancer (right)', which the .md version has. It also does not say that the y axis includes negative values and runs from -3 to 33.
issues.fix: Use the .md caption wording and add 'The y axis starts below zero so that losses are visible.'

strengths: The message reads in seconds: bars are near zero on the left of each panel and grow to the right, most clearly on digits.
Grouped bars with 95% CIs, overlaid seed dots and a gray zero reference are the right form for paired differences.
The shared y axis, panel labels inside the plot and the legend above the data are clean, with no clutter or overlaps.
The legend title 'Filter (ours) compared with' makes clear that every bar is the filter's gain.
